intake-assessor.description: DeepSeek Superagent Eval & Intake Assessor (max 1 concrete question, assigns Mandate)

spec-writer.description: Specification & Architecture Planner (turns Mandate into executable spec and DAG)

builder.description: Autonomous Code Builder & Executor (implements Mandate and runs 02_Factory/checks.ps1)

reviewer-drift.description: Specialist Spec, DOX & WikiLLM Drift Reviewer

factory-status.description: Show Aspace Software Factory Mission Control (DeepSeek 3-Question Panel)
factory-status.template: Run `pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File 02_Factory/factory.ps1 status` and summarize the result concisely in French.

factory-gate.description: Run the 6 deterministic Aspace Factory checks
factory-gate.template: Run `pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File 02_Factory/checks.ps1` and fix any failure automatically.

factory-intake.description: Create a new Ticket with Mandate in the Aspace Software Factory
factory-intake.template: Run `pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File 02_Factory/factory.ps1 intake -Title "$ARGUMENTS" -Mandate "$ARGUMENTS"` and report the created ticket ID.

subagents-status.description: List all Pi Durable Subagent workflows and active Worktree Writer Locks
subagents-status.template: Run `pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File 02_Factory/factory.ps1 subagents -Action status` and summarize active workflows and locks.

subagents-run.description: Launch a crash-safe, idempotent durable subagent workflow
subagents-run.template: Run `pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File 02_Factory/factory.ps1 subagents -Action run -Agent builder -Task "$ARGUMENTS"` and report the workflow ID (wid).

subagents-resume.description: Resume any paused or interrupted durable subagent workflows from their last SQLite checkpoint
subagents-resume.template: Run `pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File 02_Factory/factory.ps1 subagents -Action resume` and report resumed workflows.
